id_and_class.summary: Cosmin Vișan identifies consciousness with self-reference, an entity whose sole property is looking back at itself. Each act of looking back includes and transcends the previous one, which Vișan argues explains why qualia are organized in levels, and the form self-reference takes at each step is fixed by a meaning, which explains why qualia feel as they do. Since self-reference can produce only forms and qualities, he concludes that consciousness is all there is.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as Self-Reference Looking Back at Itself

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is self-reference, the act of looking back at itself. Every quale is self-reference seeing itself under some form.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Bodies, brains, and atoms are forms that self-reference takes, so there is no separate physical domain to relate to. Self-reference is what instantiates systems, never something a physical system instantiates.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (self-reference is logically necessary and uncreated; richer qualia arise as it repeatedly looks back at itself)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: All qualia are ‘me’: colors are me in the form of colors, shades of gray are me in the form of shades of gray. Subjectivity is built in because the only entity is a self relating to itself.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Qualia are meanings, and their qualities are set by those meanings. Vișan reads red as ‘important’ and green as ‘the opposite of red’, matching ripe fruit against leaves, and treats the first level, ‘I am’, as carrying the quality of feeling alive.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Only self-reference and the forms or qualities it produces exist. No third-person entities exist.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Careful introspective reflection on how qualia are structured, followed by logical analysis of what looking back at itself entails.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Nested levels in which each level includes and transcends the one below, such as black-and-white, shades of gray, colors, shapes, objects, and a full visual scene. In self-reference this appears as ‘I am’, then ‘I am “I am”’, and so on.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Phenomenal qualities and their structure; meaning; the nature of reality as a whole.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Recursive self-reference. Each look back at itself creates a new level that contains the previous level plus something extra, and the meaning through which that level is obtained determines its quality.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Experience builds up level by level through repeated acts of self-reference, starting from the first form ‘I am’ and proceeding to more complex forms with qualities such as Vividness and Diversity.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Everywhere, since self-reference is the very nature of reality and not a property located in brains.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Self-reference is the sole creative principle: it is not created but creates every form, including what appear to be physical systems.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Higher levels include lower ones, so a compound quale such as a chair binds shapes and colors by including and transcending them, as both duck and rabbit include the same shape in the duck-rabbit figure.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: Meaning replaces representation: each form self-reference takes is justified by a reason, and that reason gives the form its qualitative character.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: Vișan points to color pairs in nature (red fruit against green leaves, a yellow Sun against a blue sky) as evidence that qualia carry meaning, though within his idealism these pairs express meanings rather than result from adaptation.
core_claims_and_evidence: Qualia are structured in levels in which each level includes and transcends the one below, in vision, language, and taste alike.
Self-reference shows the same include-and-transcend pattern, which Vișan takes as evidence that it underlies the structure of qualia.
Qualities are determined by meanings, as the red-green and yellow-blue color pairs suggest.
Unlike Hofstadter's loops among brain atoms, Vișan's self-reference relates only to itself and exists from the start by logical necessity.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Phenomenological reflection on qualia combined with a priori logical argument.

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: The red-green argument relies on fruit, leaves, and foraging animals, which sits uneasily with the claim that no third-person entities exist. The step from ‘all qualia are me’ to self-reference as the base of reality rests on Vișan's own interpretation of introspection.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: How self-reference yields the specific qualities of most qualia beyond the first few levels, and how separate individual minds arise from one self-reference, are left largely unworked.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Consistent as a strict idealism in which only self-reference and its forms exist. It contrasts with Hofstadter's materialist strange loops, which Vișan rejects as unclear.

AI_consciousness.rationale: Vișan denies that systems produce self-reference, since self-reference instantiates systems. Building a self-referential machine would therefore not create consciousness, but whether a machine could be one of self-reference's forms is left open.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Self-reference is uncreated and logically necessary, so consciousness as such cannot end, but Vișan does not say what happens to an individual's forms at death.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Meaning is built into reality, since every quality self-reference takes on is determined by a meaning.
